verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key and HSM product line for FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP, PIV and encrypted storage. Generating AI insights and suggestions from user data inside the product is outside what this kind of authentication hardware does. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability, so this is a wrong-axis story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
